messages:
Olivia: Quick QTR check — can owners drop 1-line status: what shipped this sprint, what slipped, and next immediate step? Need final slide deck by EOD Thu.
Sanjay: Integrations v2: slipped. Third-party schema changed, blocked our adapter tests. Next: I can mock the new schema and land a hotfix by Tue.
Mae: Optimize/tokenizer work shipped yesterday (quant perf +2.3%).
Mae: Model eval harness still in review, slipped one day, Ryan to help unblock infra.
Ryan: I can jump on the eval infra PR today, ping me the link.
Anya: SDK batching PR #482 needs one more review (perf regression check). Jordan, could you take a look?
Jordan: putting it on my queue now, should review within 4hrs.
Ryan: FYI deploy-bot reports 2 staging flakies after the quant rollout — I've isolated to CUDA driver mismatch.
deploy-bot: [auto] New staging failures: 2 tests failed on node gpu-stg-3 — see CI dashboard: https://ci.internal/reports/2754
Sanjay: For Integrations v2, owners: Sanjay (adapter), Anya (product spec), Jordan (SDK changes).
Anya: Confirmed. I'll update the spec doc and add acceptance tests.
Olivia: Can each owner add a single next-step timeline here (today / tomorrow / by EOD Thu)? We need the slide.
Sanjay: Next-step: mock schema + adapter hotfix — by Tue EOD.
Anya: Update spec + add test vectors — by Wed noon.
Jordan: SDK CR review + address perf notes — by Wed EOD.
Mae: Eval harness review — Ryan pairing this afternoon, target Wed AM.
Ryan: Pairing scheduled 3pm PST. I'll also spin a new staging node (gpu-stg-7) to avoid the driver mismatch.
Olivia: Great. Any cross-team deps we should call out?
Jordan: Ops: need permission for canary deploy window (2hr) to validate SDK batching in prod.
Ryan: Ops good, please file the standard canary request in #eng-infra with target time.
Anya: I'll schedule the canary for Fri morning and add rollback plan.
Sanjay: Risk: Integrations v2 can slip another sprint if the third party changes schema again — recommend a short contract test run with them tomorrow.
Olivia: Good point. Anya, can you coordinate that with partner?
Anya: Yep, I'll ping them after this thread.
Olivia: Slide owner for the deck: Olivia will assemble, but please add 1-line bullets in the shared doc: https://docs.internal/qtr-slides/2754 — by Thu noon.
Jordan: Adding bullets now.
Mae: Adding shipped metrics + perf number.
Sanjay: I'll add blocker notes and contingency plan.
Olivia: Thanks all. If anything slips past Wed EOD, call it out early so we can re-scope the deck. :thumbsup:
Jordan: quick note — tagging @Ryan for final perf numbers before canary.
Ryan: got it. Will post numbers after pairing.
Olivia: OK closing thread — feel free to @mention me if you need decisions. Thanks! :party:
